{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Select only the two columns we need
subset = penguins[['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g']]

# Check how many rows have missing values in either column
missing_in_both = subset.isnull().any(axis=1).sum()
print(f"Number of rows with missing values in either flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g: {missing_in_both}")

# Compute correlation
# This drops rows with any missing values in either column
correlation = subset.corr().iloc[0, 1]
print(f"Pearson correlation between flipper_length_mm and body_mass_g: {correlation}")"}
